hero.headline: O.P. Jindal Global University 1-Year Online MBA in Human Resource Management: Fees, Syllabus and Career Scope
hero.sub: AACSB-accredited business school (JGBS). Institution of Eminence (IoE). JGU lists 72 credits in 12 months. QS 5 Star rated.

sections.tldr: Backed by the AACSB accreditation of Jindal Global Business School and IoE status from the Ministry of Education. Built for HR professionals with 3-8 years of experience in talent acquisition, HR business partnering, L&D, or total rewards who want an internationally benchmarked MBA in one year.

about.body:
O.P. Jindal Global University (JGU) is one of only four private universities in India to hold Institution of Eminence (IoE) status, declared by the Ministry of Education under UGC (Institutions of Eminence Deemed to be Universities) Regulations, 2017. This IoE designation grants JGU the autonomy to design innovative programmes, including its 1-year online MBA.

JGU lists the programme at 72 credits in 12 months, the same credit load as conventional 2-year MBA programmes compressed into an accelerated format.

JGU's business school, Jindal Global Business School, holds AACSB accreditation. The university is also QS 5 Star rated and UGC recognised. The HRM MBA targets HR professionals in talent management, HR business partnering, organisational development, or total rewards who need a management degree that matches their professional ambitions without a two-year pause. Full programme details at /universities/op-jindal-global-university-online/mba.

whoHires.body:
**Industries:** IT and tech companies, BFSI, Manufacturing, Consulting firms (HR advisory), Pharmaceuticals, E-commerce, Conglomerates

**Mid-level roles:** HR Business Partner, Talent Acquisition Lead, L&D Manager, Total Rewards Manager, Employee Experience Manager, HR Analytics Lead

**Senior roles:** Head of HR, VP People and Culture, CHRO (mid-size firms), Director Talent Management, Head of Total Rewards, Global HR Lead

**Target organisations:** MNCs with India operations, top-tier IT services firms, consulting firms with HR advisory practices, and high-growth startups scaling their people function.

Note: JGU's 1-year MBA is designed for working professionals seeking career acceleration, not entry-level placement.

**How to check placement claims:** ask O.P. Jindal Global University Online for its latest placement report in writing, for your programme and mode. Online batches are often reported apart from campus ones, or not at all. edifyedu.in does not publish employer lists it cannot source. Treat the roles above as the kinds of jobs this syllabus prepares you for, not as a list of who has hired from this batch.

skills.body:
The JGU HRM specialisation builds skills that senior HR leaders and CHROs test during lateral hiring:

- Performance Management: Design OKR cascades, build calibration processes, implement continuous feedback systems, and link performance data to compensation and succession decisions
- Talent Management: Build strategic workforce plans, create succession pipelines for critical roles, design employer branding strategies, and implement high-potential identification frameworks
- Compensation and Benefits: Conduct market benchmarking, design total rewards structures (base, variable, equity, benefits), perform pay equity audits, and build compensation philosophy documents
- Employee Wellbeing: Design mental health support programmes, build burnout prevention frameworks, implement flexible work policies, and measure wellbeing ROI for business cases

- HR Analytics: Use people data for attrition prediction, engagement driver analysis, and workforce cost modelling to present data-driven recommendations to leadership
- Organisational Design: Restructure teams and reporting lines to align people strategy with business transformation goals

**Leadership skills:** Lead HR transformation projects, present people strategy to boards, manage cross-functional stakeholders during organisational change, and build HR team capability.

certificate.body: The O.P. Jindal Global University MBA degree certificate carries the JGU name, the MBA designation, and identifies the Human Resource Management specialisation. JGU is UGC recognised and holds Institution of Eminence status from the Ministry of Education. Its business school, Jindal Global Business School, holds AACSB accreditation. AACSB accredits business schools, so the credit belongs to Jindal Global Business School rather than to JGU as a whole. JGU's IoE status and the AACSB accreditation of its business school distinguish this certificate from standard online MBA degrees in India.

faqs.question: How can JGU offer a 1-year MBA?
faqs.answer: JGU holds Institution of Eminence (IoE) status under UGC (Institutions of Eminence Deemed to be Universities) Regulations, 2017. IoE status grants autonomy for innovative programme design, including accelerated formats. The 1-year MBA covers 72 credits, the same credit load as conventional 2-year MBA programmes, compressed into 12 months. Only four private universities in India hold IoE status.

faqs.question: What is AACSB accreditation?
faqs.answer: AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business) is an international accreditation for business schools. It signals that a business school meets international benchmarks for curriculum, faculty qualifications and learning outcomes. At JGU the accreditation belongs to Jindal Global Business School. Talk to our counsellor about how it applies to the online MBA.

faqs.question: Is JGU's 1-year MBA valid?
faqs.answer: JGU runs its 1-year online MBA under its Institution of Eminence status. Institutions of Eminence can run online programmes without prior UGC approval. JGU does not appear on the UGC-DEB entitlement list of August 2026, so confirm with JGU which approval the programme rests on. JGU lists the programme at 72 credits in 12 months.

faqs.question: Can I pursue SHRM or CIPD certification alongside this MBA?
faqs.answer: Yes. The HRM specialisation content (performance management, compensation, talent management) aligns well with SHRM-CP/SCP and CIPD frameworks. The 1-year MBA format means you complete the degree first and can then pursue SHRM or CIPD certification without overlapping commitments. The AACSB accreditation of JGU's business school combined with SHRM or CIPD creates a strong HR leadership profile.

faqs.question: Is this MBA suitable for transitioning into HR from another function?
faqs.answer: The programme is designed for professionals with existing work experience.
